model: Model FP-624D MicroSafe combustible gas sensor (RS-485 Modbus)
applies_to: Teledyne Detcon FP-624D MicroSafe catalytic LEL sensor with 4-20 mA, relays and RS-485 Modbus RTU, instruction manual Document #3598 Rev. 1.7.
summary: The FP-624D is a Detcon catalytic-bead combustible gas sensor with a display, three relays, a 4-20 mA loop and a Modbus RTU RS-485 port. Its holding registers follow the Detcon 700-series layout: range, gas reading in %LEL, span level, sensor life, fault bits, loop current, supply voltage, calibration command, gas/units text and firmware version.

addressing.note: Registers are printed 40000-40023 starting at 40000, so the digits after the leading 4 are the wire address: 40002 (gas reading) is address 2.

notes: Left out: special registers 40011-40014 and 40022, which the table says depend on a special-register table that this manual does not include, and 40010 temperature, whose data type (sign) is not given.
All values are single 16-bit holding registers. Function 03 reads, 06 writes.
The notation string stores the first character in the low byte of each register.
Factory serial ID is 01; set it in the menu in hex.

registers.name: Detectable range
registers.description: Full scale; read only on FP sensors.

registers.name: Gas concentration
registers.description: Gas reading in the units of the notation string (normally %LEL).

registers.name: AutoSpan level
registers.description: Span gas concentration used for calibration.

registers.name: Fault status bits
registers.description: Faults clear themselves when the condition clears.

registers.name: Calibration status / enable
registers.description: Read gives status; write starts an action.

values.1: Read: zero calibration started / Write: set zero
values.2: Read: span calibration started / Write: set span

registers.name: Gas/units notation string
registers.description: Units, a space, gas name, null-terminated; first character in the low byte.

integration.summary: Set the serial ID with the magnet menu, wire RS-485 at 9600 8N1 and poll holding registers 0-9 with function 03.
integration.enable: The manual describes no separate enable step; set a unique serial ID in the sensor menu (Set Serial ID).
quirks: The CAL LED flashes each time the sensor answers a poll.
setup: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: Bit 14 of the fault register is set during calibration.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
